criteria.evidence: packages/process-lease/src/owned-process-lease.integration.test.ts (moved from scripts/, 7 tests pass) reaches both waiter callbacks, reclaims the old owner and releases both leases under the default macOS tmpdir (/var/folders, a symlink to /private/var) and under a deliberately aliased temp parent (a symlink alias inside the scratch root); also green with TMPDIR set to the canonical /private path. On main the same test hangs 120 s at the guard checkpoint and fails (log tmp/chef/scratch/COR-2676-42cf694d/main-default.log).

The same file still refuses an ownerless directory, a live owner, a foreign record that names a live unrelated group (process left alive), and now an owner naming a non-canonical worktree spelling. The synthetic owners carry a real dead process's pid and start time and the canonical cwd, so the foreign-group refusal now comes from the gate-identity check, a stronger test than the old path mismatch.

Process identity, owner records, the reclaim guard and removal, the owned lease, group and gate moved verbatim into packages/process-lease (@lostgradient/process-lease). applications/interborough/src/host/supervisor.ts imports it directly and nothing under scripts/. applications/interborough/src/host/process-ownership-boundary.slow.test.ts bundles supervisor.ts and cli.ts and asserts no input under the repository scripts/ or testing/ (red on main: owned-process-group.ts, owned-process-lease.ts, run-exclusively.ts, hang-guard.ts, environment-configuration.ts). Queue, host slots, memory admission, Turborepo defaults and runInProcessGroup stay in scripts/run-exclusively.ts, which imports the package; no re-export layer, every importer repointed.

packages/process-lease/src/owned-process-lease.matrix.integration.test.ts: 10 owner states by acquire, retire, cleanup and repeated cleanup, 40 cells, all passing and identical on main before the move. applications/interborough/src/host/supervisor-process-ownership.integration.test.ts (8 tests): checkout startup holds exactly the scoped lease owned by its verified gate group and retires it on a clean stop; cleanup after a killed supervisor retires only the verified group and is a no-op the second time; a reused owner pid and another worktree's owner both fail closed, keep the record and leave the unrelated process alive.

The same supervisor test bundles supervisor.ts alone (its only imports are runtime builtins), runs it from a directory outside any git worktree with none of the repository's scripts on disk: it starts, creates no tmp directory or lease, stops with exit 0 and leaves no host process. The extracted release archive built at a9dc2b7650 (bin/interborough start --port 0, cwd outside a checkout, PATH minimal): listening, /host/status 200, SIGTERM exit 0, cwd left empty, no lease; the archive holds no scripts directory. The build's own relocated-host verification also passed.

Root scheduler tests preserved: run-exclusively, host-slots, host-sessions, bun-test-pool, host-lock-reclaim, merge-gate and ensure-cinder-owned suites pass in the focused and test:self:slow runs with imports repointed only. Checkout verification: the focused checks and the two slow lanes above. Source-absent verification: the archive probe above and build-release's relocated host.
